heroHeadline: Taiwan Legislature Passes NT$8.81B Special Defense Procurement Budget — 3rd Reading May 29, No Opposition (HIMARS, M109A7, Anti-Armor Drones Funded); PLA 9 Sorties May 28 (All 9 Cross Median Line 100%); 10 Sorties May 29 (8 PLAN Vessels); US Autonomous Vessel 'Lightfish' Completes First Autonomous Taiwan Strait Transit — 2 Days to May 31 HIMARS Deadline
heroSubtitle: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed the NT$8.81 billion FY2026 special arms procurement budget on its third reading on May 29, 2026 — two days before the May 31 HIMARS first payment (NT$800 million) deadline — without opposition, resolving months of legislative bottleneck. The budget funds 82 HIMARS launchers (NT$2.8B), M109A7 self-propelled howitzers (NT$3.9B), anti-armor drone systems (NT$1.8B), Javelin ATGMs, and TOW 2B anti-armor missiles. The legislation also authorizes up to NT$780 billion in total US arms procurement through 2033. Defense Minister Wellington Koo had testified on May 26 that HIMARS provides Taiwan with 300 km deep-strike capability against PLA missile platforms. PLA activity remained elevated: on May 28, Taiwan's MND detected 9 sorties with all 9 (100%) crossing the median line into central and southwestern ADIZ sectors with 6 PLAN vessels; on May 29, Taiwan detected 10 sorties, 8 PLAN vessels, and 4 additional ships. The full May 2026 sortie sequence now reads: 4→29→1→2→1→0→22→12→8→12→7→9→2→3→15→6→7→13→24→7→6→16→4→9→26→10→9→10. In a significant technological development, the US autonomous uncrewed surface vessel 'Lightfish' completed the first-ever autonomous transit of the Taiwan Strait in late May 2026, covering over 1,000 nautical miles in five days while monitoring ship traffic — encountering PLA Navy Type 056 corvettes operating without AIS transponders within Taiwan's EEZ. No Trump-Lai direct call has been confirmed; Taiwan's Foreign Minister stated on May 25 that 'no planning talks have taken place.' The $14B PAC-3/NASAMS package remains 'in abeyance' and the US FMS pause for Operation Epic Fury (Iran) is still active.
